links.outcome: ChatGPT accuracy versus AAO-HNS clinical practice guidelines across otolaryngology subspecialties
links.effect: 59.7% (43/72) highly accurate; 2.8% (2/72) directly contradicted guidelines; accuracy 100% Head and Neck, 66% Rhinology and Otology, 50% Laryngology, 8% Pediatrics.
links.quote: The model showed 100% accuracy in Head and Neck, but lower accuracy in Rhinology and Otology/Neurotology (66%), Laryngology (50%), and Pediatrics (8%).

links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT responses across three repeated runs of the same questions
links.effect: Responses consistent in 17/24 (70.8%) of questions; Cronbach's alpha 0.87.
links.quote: The model's responses were consistent in 17/24 (70.8%), with a Cronbach's alpha value of 0.87, indicating a reasonable consistency across tests.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's adherence to clinical guidelines on otolaryngology questions without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
